description:
A Marine Cargo Surveyor needs a preliminary stowage manifest for a chemical tanker. Look up the following five liquid bulk chemicals on CAMEO Chemicals (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/): Acrylonitrile, Morpholine, Styrene monomer, Sulfuric acid, and Propionic acid. 

For each chemical, navigate to its datasheet and find the 'Chemical Identifiers' section. Extract the 'USCG CHRIS Code' (3-letter code) and the 'USCG Compatibility Group' number. 

Create a CSV file at '~/Desktop/marine_manifest.csv' with the headers 'Chemical Name, CHRIS Code, USCG Group'. Enter the data for all five chemicals. 

Note: Ensure you use the USCG Compatibility Group number (used for 46 CFR 150), NOT the NOAA Reactive Group.
